commercial_clauses.details: Initial term of 3 years with an optional extension of 2 years, subject to Bank satisfaction and mutual agreement.
Services to be provided on an as-required basis, allowing flexibility in engagement timing and volume.
Procurement subject to Canadian Free Trade Agreement (CFTA) requirements.
Proponents acknowledge that the statement of work may be adjusted if selected to negotiate with the Bank of Canada.
RFP process does not constitute a legally binding bidding process. No legal relationship or obligations are created unless and until Bank of Canada and selected proponent enter into a contract.

Proponents may propose hourly rates, daily rates, fixed fees, subscription models, bundled pricing, retainers, or other pricing models, provided that the standardized evaluated scenario is priced for evaluation purposes using Bank-provided specifications.

For Year 2 and Year 3 rates, proponents must identify the Maximum Annual Increase for Option Years in the rate card. Proponents must provide pricing for Years 2 and 3 for delivering identical engagement in evaluated pricing scenarios.

Learning and Development: Travel expenses and venue costs, catering, participant technology, and internal Bank resources excluded. HR Advisory: Travel expenses excluded. Facilitation: Travel expenses and venue costs, catering, participant technology, and internal Bank resources excluded.

Pricing must include all professional fees, preparation time, delivery time, reporting, project management, materials, tools, administrative costs, third-party fees, and any other mandatory costs required to deliver applicable services.

Where a service is included in a subscription, retainer, bundle, or base fee, proponents must identify the service in the category rate card. Services included in bundles or subscriptions must be documented in rate card Notes/Restrictions column.
The evaluated quantities are for evaluation purposes only and do not represent a commitment by the Bank to purchase any minimum volume.

contract_risks.details: Suppliers must satisfy three separate mandatory criteria sets (B1, B2, B3) and three minimum qualification requirement sets (C1, C2, C3) to proceed to evaluation. Failure in any category results in automatic rejection.

contract_risks.risk: Undefined Evaluation Weights for Rated Criteria
contract_risks.details: Appendix D1 and D2 rated criteria response forms are referenced but specific scoring weights and thresholds are not detailed in this abstract document.
Appendix F ESG Questionnaire is mandatory; environmental, social, and governance performance will be assessed as part of evaluation.
Appendix G Form of Agreement must be accepted as submitted; suppliers may have limited negotiation flexibility on contractual terms and conditions.
Separate submission envelopes for proposal and pricing reduce opportunity for integrated cost-benefit narratives; pricing cannot be modified after identity envelope acceptance.
Explicitly stated that ESG responses will not be used for proposal evaluation or future Bank participation decisions, limiting contractual impact.
Inaccurate, misleading or incomplete information, including withdrawn or altered pricing, could adversely impact proposal acceptance or proponent's eligibility for future work.

Proponent must declare conflicts of interest, including unfair advantages in bidding, access to confidential information not available to others, communication to influence treatment, or financial interests that could impair objective judgment in contract performance. Failure to declare results in deemed no-conflict status.
Proponent must provide list of subcontractors and ensure they comply with forced labour/child labour requirements and other contractual obligations.

contract_risks.risk: Forced Labour and Child Labour Compliance
contract_risks.details: Proponent and subcontractors must not use or tolerate forced labour or child labour, must have implemented rigorous policies and due diligence, and must comply with the Fighting Against Forced Labour and Child Labour in Supply Chains Act (SC 2023, c 9).
Signatory must confirm authority to bind the proponent; lack of authority could invalidate the submission.

All service provider resources must successfully obtain and maintain Reliability clearance including electronic fingerprints, criminal record check, credit check, and security screening interview. Failure of any resource to meet clearance requirements could impact service delivery.
All digital learning content must comply with CAN/ASC - EN 301 549:2024 and WCAG standards. Non-compliance with Accessible Canada Act requirements could expose the Bank to regulatory and legal risk.

Service provider must consistently deliver all services, materials and solutions in both English and French throughout contract term. Resource turnover or capacity issues could impact ability to maintain bilingual delivery.

All service provider resources must obtain and maintain Reliability clearance including electronic fingerprints, criminal record check, credit check, and potential security screening interview. Failure to meet clearance requirements may result in resource ineligibility.

Service provider must demonstrate capability to deliver all services, materials and solutions in both English and French. Non-compliance with bilingualism requirement may result in proposal rejection.

All Service Provider resources must obtain Reliability clearance including electronic fingerprints, criminal record check, credit check, and potential security screening interview. Non-compliance or clearance failure could result in resource replacement or contract termination.

All digital learning content must comply with multiple accessibility standards (CAN/ASC - EN 301 549:2024, EN 301 549:2021, WCAG). Non-compliance exposes the Bank to Accessible Canada Act violations and potential regulatory penalties.
Provider must maintain capacity to deliver all services, materials, and solutions in both official languages. Language delivery failures could result in contract disputes or service termination.
Requirement mandates minimum 5 dedicated L&D professionals including specific senior roles; vendor failure to maintain this capacity could impact service delivery.
Vendor must demonstrate three similar engagements within 5 years for organizations with 1,000+ employees; inadequate documentation could result in disqualification.

Proponents must substantiate three separate qualification thresholds (engagement count, resource seniority, organizational scale); failure to document evidence adequately may result in disqualification regardless of rated proposal quality.

Proponents are permitted to anonymize client organization names and case study details if confidentiality applies, but must provide verifiable client reference contact information for all three reference engagements.
Proponents must clearly identify any requirements that fall outside their firm's scope of services. Proponents will be evaluated only on service categories for which they submit responses.
All three reference facilitation engagements must have been completed within the last three (3) years, creating potential risk if proponent cannot demonstrate recent relevant experience.

Failure to provide sufficient pricing information to calculate the Total Evaluated Category Price may result in the proposal being found non-compliant or receiving no pricing points for that category. All cost assumptions, restrictions, exceptions, and exclusions must be clearly documented.
Pricing must not be included in any other part of the proposal. All pricing must be contained solely within the Pricing Form. Costs not disclosed in this Pricing Form may not be payable by the Bank.

Proponents must price standardized scenarios as provided by the Bank. Pricing must not rely on information not provided in the RFP. Any deviations from scenario specifications must be clearly documented with associated cost impacts.

Learning and Development: All participant materials, facilitator materials, and supporting resources must be provided in both English and French. HR Advisory and Facilitation: Engagement deliverables (reports, presentations, assessments) specified as English only. Bilingual delivery of meetings/interviews required as needed. Language translation costs must be included in pricing.

contract_risks.risk: Rate Escalation and Maximum Increase Disclosure
contract_risks.details: Proponents must identify Maximum Annual Increase for Option Years in rate card. Year 2 and Year 3 rates must be provided in rate cards and evaluated scenarios. Escalation limitations must be clearly stated to avoid disputes over allowable increases in contract option years.
